acceptance: 1) Establish strict Zod request/response schemas by checking every field against section 10; derive types only from schemas, make the public index consumable by independent TypeScript code, and reject unknown or out-of-bound fields. 2) LoginMode accepts only password/totp; missing rememberDevice, boolean false and literal false parse as false, while other invalid values are rejected. (E-95).

E-95.trigger: Auth.js form rememberDevice is literal false, missing or boolean false
E-95.expect: Explicitly parse it as false and use the normal two-hour policy. Do not use Boolean or unconstrained coercion to turn it into remembered-device mode; reject other invalid values.
